textos.Muitas reviews descrevem o filme como um: Many reviews describe the film as a soulless, hollow and purely commercial production that replaces the charm and magic of the original with a cold, calculated digital aesthetic.
textos.Os efeitos gerados por computador são cr: The computer-generated effects are criticized as ugly, poorly made and excessive, with digital characters that seem out of place and lifeless, hurting immersion.
textos.Várias pessoas questionam por que refaze: Several people question why remake a classic that already worked perfectly, pointing out that the new version adds nothing new and feels like nostalgic exploitation without artistic purpose.
textos.Atuação de Tom Hanks e elenco: Tom Hanks's performance and the cast
textos.A atuação de Tom Hanks é vista como esfo: Tom Hanks's performance is seen as earnest but misguided, with an unstable accent and exaggerations that do not convince, while the rest of the cast is considered apathetic or poorly used.
textos.O filme é frequentemente classificado co: The film is often described as boring and slow, with a narrative that fails to hold attention and makes the running time seem excessive.
textos.Muitos destacam que o remake perde compl: Many highlight that the remake completely loses the emotion, charm and daring of the original, resulting in an inferior version that does not justify its existence.
textos.As reviews medianas elogiam a qualidade: The middling reviews praise the overall quality of the CGI, but point out inconsistencies in some scenes and characters, such as the cat and the little fish, which sound artificial or unfinished.
textos.Comparação com a animação original e out: Comparison with the original animation and other remakes
textos.Este grupo destaca que o remake é fiel e: This group highlights that the remake is faithful in several moments, but does not reach the magic of the animated classic and at times changes songs and characters unnecessarily.
textos.As reviews medianas consideram Tom Hanks: The middling reviews consider Tom Hanks charismatic and fitting as Geppetto, although some criticize his reduced screen time or acting choices; Cynthia Erivo as the Blue Fairy is often praised.
textos.Parte deste grupo sente que o filme é ap: A portion of this group feels that the film is rushed in some stretches and fails to generate emotional connection or the magic needed to captivate.
textos.As reviews medianas criticam as novas ca: The middling reviews criticize the new songs and the changes to the originals, but praise Alan Silvestri's score and Cynthia Erivo's performance.
textos.Este grupo menciona que o filme parece u: This group mentions that the film feels like a pointless remake, made for profit, and that a superior animated version already exists.
textos.Fidelidade e nostalgia em relação ao clá: Fidelity and nostalgia toward the classic
textos.Muitas reviews positivas destacam que a: Many positive reviews highlight that the adaptation keeps the essence of the original animation, respecting its classic elements and awakening nostalgia in fans.
textos.O CGI e o design de produção são elogiad: The CGI and the production design are praised for their quality, with detailed sets and visually captivating characters, although some point to oddities in the look.
textos.As atuações, especialmente as de Tom Han: The performances, especially those of Tom Hanks, Benjamin Evan Ainsworth and Cynthia Erivo, receive praise for their emotion and charisma, despite a few isolated criticisms.
textos.A trilha sonora e as canções clássicas s: The score and the classic songs are remembered fondly, contributing to the film's magical, nostalgic atmosphere.
textos.As reviews ressaltam que o filme transmi: The reviews stress that the film conveys lessons about honesty, courage, friendship and love, being considered educational and moving for all ages.

textos.Algumas reviews mencionam que, embora ex: Some reviews mention that, although there are other adaptations, this version stands out as one of Disney's best remakes, despite the negative reviews it received.

textos.Lançado no ano de 2022 sob a direção de: Released in 2022 and directed by Robert Zemeckis, the feature film Pinocchio runs 111 minutes and combines the fantasy, adventure and family genres. The narrative reconstructs the tale of the wooden puppet in a spine-tingling adventure to become a real boy, retold for a new audiovisual experience.
textos.Na maioria das notas (~60%), a maior par: In most ratings (~60%), most of the analyses strongly criticize the lack of soul and the artificiality observed in the film, pointing to an excessively cold result. About half express explicit dissatisfaction with the bad CGI and visual effects, highlighting digital elements that sound artificial. In addition, a significant share reinforces the needlessness of the remake, arguing that the adaptation is not justified given the impact already established by the source material.
textos.Numa parcela das notas (~25%), para quem: In a share of the ratings (~25%), for those in this intermediate range of assessment, a good portion weigh in on the visual effects and CGI, acknowledging technical competence in certain passages and flaws in others. Several turn to the comparison with the original animation and other remakes to gauge the weight of the changes made. Complementing this reading, a considerable number of texts comment on Tom Hanks's performance and the cast.
textos.Numa parcela menor das notas (~15%), sob: In a smaller share of the ratings (~15%), from the perspective of this favorable portion, many enthusiastically highlight the fidelity and nostalgia toward the classic throughout the story. A good portion clearly approves of the use of visual effects and production design in developing the sets, while a smaller slice directs its positive impressions to the cast's performances.
